tooltip.bigpickle_graverift.pierced_ende: A cold weight. It remembers what you lost, but cannot yet open the way.
tooltip.bigpickle_graverift.grave_rift: Use on a living creature to tear open a path to your last place of death. The path will not remain open for long.
message.bigpickle_graverift.no_last_deat: The rift finds no echo of a death to follow.
